summary: First-finish smoke test of Breast Cancer AI Classification app. Backend auth (register, session via Bearer/cookie), dashboard stats, predictions POST/GET, model info all pass. Frontend flow verified end-to-end: landing -> register -> dashboard -> 30-feature prediction form (3 groups) -> result page (Malignant, 76.5% confidence, recommendation) -> history table -> about page. Protected routes correctly redirect to /login when unauthenticated.
passed: GET / (landing) returns 200 with hero + feature cards (AI-Powered Analysis, 98% Accuracy, Secure & Private)
POST /api/auth/register creates user, returns session_token, sets cookie
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns 200 user profile
POST /api/predictions with 30-float array returns prediction with result/confidence
UI: Login page has Login/Register tabs, Google button visible
UI: Registration form (Full Name/Email/Password) creates account and lands on /dashboard
UI: Dashboard shows welcome, stats (Total/Benign/Malignant/Accuracy 97%), Recent Predictions, nav links
UI: Prediction form renders 30 number inputs organized under Mean / Standard Error / Worst
UI: Submitting 30 features + patient name shows /result page with diagnosis, confidence bar, recommendation, prediction ID
UI: History page shows submitted prediction in table with patient/result/confidence/date
UI: About page renders SVM model info
Protected routes (/dashboard) redirect to /login when cookies/localStorage cleared

failed.issue: GET /api/auth/me returns the bcrypt password_hash in the user payload. Sensitive field should be stripped from response.

Seeded test users doctor@test.com / admin@test.com listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md do NOT exist in DB. Login returns 401 Invalid credentials. Either seed them at startup or update the credentials file.
failed.evidence: POST /api/auth/login {email: doctor@test.com, password: test123} -> 401 Invalid credentials

action_items: Strip password_hash (and any sensitive fields) from GET /api/auth/me response (project by ,{'_id':0,'password_hash':0} or use a Pydantic response_model).
Seed the documented test users (doctor@test.com / admin@test.com) on startup, OR update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to reflect that fresh registration is required.
notes: Google OAuth button visible; full OAuth flow not exercised (requires real Google login, per request). SVM predictions functional end-to-end. No hot-reload, code, or dependency changes made during testing.
